from: https://nida.nih.gov/api/cme/873, NIDA's BSTAD API, which the BSTAD web app at https://nida.nih.gov/bstad loads
terms: A U.S. government work. Ask NIH, 2026-10-18: "You may include it with that attribute."
about: Each question, answer and listed condition as NIDA's API gives it, HTML removed and spaces collapsed. The test checks each one appears unchanged in the document.
texts: In the PAST YEAR, on how many days did you smoke cigarettes or use other tobacco products?
In the PAST YEAR, on how many days did you have more than a few sips of beer, wine, or any drink containing alcohol?
In the PAST YEAR, on how many days did you use marijuana (weed; blunts)?
In the PAST YEAR, which of the following substances have you used? (check all that apply)
Cocaine or crack
Heroin
Amphetamines or Methamphetamines (non-medication)
Hallucinogen (e.g., magic mushrooms, LSD, etc.)
Inhalants (e.g., huffing gasoline, glue, nitrous oxide, etc.)
None of the above
In the PAST YEAR, which of the following medications have you used that
Prescription pain relievers (e.g., morphine, Percocet, vicodin, oxycontin, dilaudid, methadone, buprenorphine, etc.)
Prescription sedatives (e.g., Valium, Xanax, Klonopin, Ativan, etc.)
Prescription stimulants (e.g., Adderall, Ritalin, etc.)
Over-the-counter medications (e.g., NyQuil, Benadryl, cough medicine, sleeping pills)
Were not prescribed for you; or
Which you took more of than you were supposed to take?
In the PAST YEAR, on how many days did you use cocaine or crack?
In the PAST YEAR, on how many days did you use heroin?
In the PAST YEAR, on how many days did you use amphetamines or methamphetamine (non-medication)?
In the PAST YEAR, on how many days did you use hallucinogens (e.g., mushrooms, LSD)?
In the PAST YEAR, on how many days did you use inhalants?

In the PAST YEAR, on how many days did you use prescription pain relievers (e.g., morphine, vicodin, oxycotin, dilaudid, methadone, buprenorphine, etc.) that were not prescribed for you or more than you were supposed to?
In the PAST YEAR, on how many days did you use prescription sedatives (e.g., Valium, Xanax, Klonopin, Ativan, etc.) that were not prescribed for you or more than you were supposed to?
In the PAST YEAR, on how many days did you use prescription stimulants (e.g., Adderall, Ritalin, etc.) that were not prescribed for you or more than you were supposed to?
In the PAST YEAR, on how many days did you use over-the-counter medications [more than you were supposed to use] (e.g., NyQuil, Benadryl, cough medicine, sleeping pills, etc.)?
